summary.title: [404 Testing] Missing paths return Python’s generic error page during local verification
summary.one_line_description: The Playwright server does not serve the built Shoppa 404 document for an unknown URL, while the test checks the 404 status and custom content in separate responses.

bug_1.file_locations: - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/playwright.config.ts - `webServer.command`, Lines 19-26 - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/test/agent-readiness.spec.ts - test: `the static 404 artefact gives agents explicit discovery recovery paths`, Lines 13-30

issue_description.description: The local browser server uses Python’s unmodified `SimpleHTTPRequestHandler`. For `/agent-readiness-missing-page/`, that handler returns HTTP 404 with its own `Error response` HTML and no links to `/sitemap.xml` or `/llms.txt`; it never reads `dist/404.html`. The test still passes because it asserts the status on the missing URL, then opens `/404.html` as a separate HTTP 200 URL before checking the Shoppa content. This does not exercise the required contract that one missing-path response combines a real 404 status with Shoppa’s recovery body, and it leaves that deployed behaviour unverified without a production service. Reproduce after `pnpm build` by starting the configured Python handler and requesting an unknown route: the response title and heading are `Error response`, and neither required recovery link is present. Use a local static handler that maps unknown paths to `dist/404.html` while retaining status 404, then make the test assert the status and recovery links from that same missing-path response.
issue_description.expected_vs_actual: | Aspect | Expected | Actual | |--------|----------|--------| | **Missing-path status** | HTTP 404 | HTTP 404 | | **Missing-path body** | Built Shoppa 404 content | Python `SimpleHTTPRequestHandler` generic error document | | **Recovery links** | `/sitemap.xml` and `/llms.txt` in the 404 response | Neither link appears in the missing-path response | | **Test coverage** | One response proves the status and custom recovery body together | Separate `/agent-readiness-missing-page/` and `/404.html` requests let the test pass without proving the combined contract |
